title: The Strange Visitors of a Walled City
intro: A group arrived at the gates of a city whose people had never known truth. They brought a message, but the inhabitants turned hostile, threatening violence. Yet, from an unexpected place, a single voice rose to defend the strangers, setting the stage for a dramatic turn of events.
clues: We entered a city whose people were engulfed in disbelief.
They looked at us with suspicion and said, 'You are only ordinary beings like us.'
We warned them, but they raised stones against us.
A man rushed from the farthest end of the city to affirm our truth.
He declared to his people, 'Why should I not worship the One who created me?'
The city's denial ended with a single blast, and silence reigned where once they jeered.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
